status_summary: The 2027 Notice of Benefit and Payment Parameters final rule, published 2026-05-20 and effective 2026-07-20, adds 45 CFR 156.236 to let non-network plans, which set benefit amounts that providers accept as payment in full and which analysts describe as relying on reference-based pricing, be certified as qualified health plans from plan year 2027 on State Exchanges and 2028 on the federal Exchange. It also allows value-based insurance designs in multi-year catastrophic plans. On 2026-07-16 the District of Maryland stayed the non-network provisions pending a merits ruling in City of Columbus v. Kennedy, and CMS confirmed both are paused. No action addresses shared savings designs. The Transparency in Coverage final rule of 2026-10-06 expands price disclosure.

timeline.event: HHS publishes the 2027 Notice of Benefit and Payment Parameters final rule (FR doc 2026-10050, effective 2026-07-20), adding 45 CFR 156.236 so that non-network plans, which set benefit amounts that providers accept as payment in full, can be certified as qualified health plans, from plan year 2027 on State Exchanges that allow them and from 2028 on the federal Exchange.

The U.S. District Court for the District of Maryland, in City of Columbus v. Kennedy (No. 1:26-cv-02215), stays under 5 U.S.C. 705 eight groups of the rule's provisions, including the addition of 45 CFR 156.236, pending a ruling on the merits.
